note: Wikimedia Commons, “St. Iphigenia, Virgin Met DP891127.jpg”; artist as recorded there: Jacques Callot — fetched 03 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: The Metropolitan Museum's own title for the print, which Commons carries, is St Iphigenia, Virgin. The calendar keeps one Iphigenia, the Ethiopian virgin converted by the apostle Matthew, on 16 November, which is this folder's Greek feast and this folder's rank; The plate is from Callot's Les Images de Tous les Saints and is lettered on the picture itself «S. IPHIGENIA VIRG» with «21» and «Sept» in the lower corners — the Western day, kept with the apostle Matthew who baptised her, where the Greek calendar this folder reads keeps her on 16 November.
